articles.summary: In many segments of P&C insurance, the industry is going through what is known as a "hard market" in which prices are high and underwriting capacity is scarce. These conditions are due to many simultaneous challenges: economic inflation, financial volatility, unexpectedly high jury awards, expensive reinsurance, and more frequent natural catastrophes.
